newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba falls, pressured by earnings forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba falls, pressured by earnings forecasts.

text.p: Toshiba Corp shares fell in early Monday morning trade, pressured by a downward revision in its earnings forecasts announced on Friday, brokers said.
As of 0020 GMT, the leading electronics maker was down eight yen at 672 yen in a trade of 1.323 million shares. It was the most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
On Friday, Toshiba said it expected its parent current profit for the year to March 31 to be 90.0 billion yen, compared to a previous forecast of 125.0 billion.
It also said its group current profit was seen falling to 120.0 billion yen from an earlier prediction of 160.0 billion yen.
